In the first scene, as I observe the group through the glass, I feel the quiet curiosity of an outsider looking in—a witness to communal learning, yet separated, reflecting on the boundaries that define participation and observation. There is a sense of anticipation, wondering about the ideas being exchanged.

In the second scene, the vibrant R+D wall beckons me into a world of innovation and knowledge. I am filled with awe at the intersection of research and creativity displayed before me. The environment feels charged with possibility, and I feel inspired, eager to engage with the ideas and discoveries unfolding on these colorful surfaces.
